name: veiled-rolls
description: Foundry VTT (D&D5e) module: GM-veiled skill/ability/save rolls answered by private, pre-written narrative responses.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf build && mkdir -p build/veiled-rolls && cp -r module.json README.md CHANGELOG.md dist lang styles templates build/veiled-rolls/ && cd build && zip -qr veiled-rolls.zip veiled-rolls
